card.name: Dose units after a number
card.fires_on: The unit mg, or /kg after mg, right after a dose amount in dosing or animal-study text. It usually comes just before a per-day or once-daily phrase.

modes.label: mg after dose number
modes.description: The unit mg directly follows a numeric dose, with a per-day or frequency phrase next.
modes.example: The recommended initial dose is 20<< mg>>/day.

modes.label: /kg after mg
modes.description: The per-body-weight part of a dose in animal study doses.
modes.example: Reproduction studies were performed at doses up to 50 mg<</kg>>/day in rats
